verdict.rationale: PayPal's docs describe payment-token authentication (Braintree single-use tokens bound to merchant ID), PayPal-issued JWTs for verifying that requests come from PayPal's own Shopping Cart service, and webhook signature verification — but none of this constitutes a verifiable agent identity system (no registered agent profiles, agent-level signatures, or trust tiers that would let a merchant distinguish which specific AI agent or bot is originating traffic). The authentication documented is merchant-to-PayPal or PayPal-to-merchant channel security, not agent-to-merchant identity/trust signaling.
